text:
The source records include measure results for hospital-acquired pressure injury rate and medication reconciliation completion at discharge. No benchmark, target, stratification, prior-period result, or explanatory note is included in the supplied records; therefore, this summary is limited to the reported measure fields.

For measure HAPI-02, “Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate,” the reported period is 2026-Q2 and the unit is percent. The numerator is 41, the denominator is 210, and exclusions are 15. The reported rate is 21.03 percent. Event dates associated with this record are 2026-01-24, 2026-07-04, 2026-07-19, 2026-09-18, and 2026-11-09.

For measure MED-REC, “Medication reconciliation completion at discharge,” the reported period is 2026-Q1 and the unit is percent. The numerator is 66, the denominator is 265, and exclusions are 2. The reported rate is 25.1 percent. Event dates associated with this record are 2026-02-09, 2026-05-02, 2026-06-13, 2026-08-15, and 2026-09-01.

Both measure records provide the core reporting elements needed for a basic quality summary: measure identifier, measure name, reporting period, numerator, denominator, exclusions, reported rate, unit, and associated event dates. The records do not include service line, facility, patient population, case-mix information, data collection method, validation status, improvement actions, or documented reasons for exclusions. As a result, no conclusions are drawn here about performance drivers, statistical significance, trend direction, preventability, compliance gaps, or comparison to external standards.
